climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A cool-climate region south of Melbourne in Victoria's Port Phillip area, focused on Pinot Noir, with Chardonnay, Pinot Gris and Tempranillo too. Wines are medium bodied and dry, and sparkling wines show structure. Pinot Noir is 55 percent of plantings.
